rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record and the reproduced TSE diploma state that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was elected President of the Republic by the will of the people expressed at the polls on 27 October 2002.

locator.section: Opening declaration by Ramez Tebet; diploma on pdf p. 4; termo on pdf p. 6

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The record reproduces the TSE diploma, dated Brasília 14 December 2002 and signed by Minister Nelson Jobim as President of the Court, with the other members of the Court, stating that Lula was elected President of the Republic and qualifying him for investiture in the office before the National Congress on 1 January 2003; the opening and termo date the diplomação to 14 December 2002.

locator.section: Facsimile of the TSE diploma ("Brasília, aos 14 de dezembro de 2002")

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the solemn joint session of 1 January 2003 (opened 15:05 in the Chamber plenary), Ramez Tebet invited Lula, "President of the Republic elect", to take the constitutional commitment standing, and Lula recited it.

locator.section: Left column: invitation and "O SR. LUIZ INÁCIO LULA DA SILVA - Prometo manter, defender e cumprir a Constituição..."

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Ramez Tebet then declared Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and José Alencar Gomes da Silva empossados as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil for the period 1 January 2003 to 31 December 2006; the session was opened to give posse to the two, diplomados for the period beginning on that date.

locator.section: Left column: "Declaro empossados ... para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2003 a 31 de dezembro de 2006"; opening on pdf p. 3 ("para o período a iniciar-se nesta data")

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The termo de posse, read in the session and reproduced with its signatures, records that at 15:00 on 1 January 2003, before the National Congress in joint session, Lula was solemnly empossado as President of the Republic under article 78 of the Constitution, elected on 27 October 2002 and diplomado by the TSE on 14 December 2002, for the period 1 January 2003 to 31 December 2006.

locator.section: Termo read (both columns); signed facsimile on pdf p. 7 (printed 000007)

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Before the termo was signed, the First Secretary of the Mesa, Deputy Severino Cavalcanti, said in the session that Lula "today assumes the Presidency of the Republic"; in his address Lula describes himself as the man who "now assumes the post" of supreme magistrate of the nation.

locator.section: Right column, Severino Cavalcanti ("hoje assume a Presidência da República"); Lula's address on pdf p. 12 ("que agora assume o posto de Supremo Mandatário da Nação")

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Congress record states that the President and Vice-President, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and José Alencar Gomes da Silva, were elected on 27 October 2002; the reproduced TSE diploma says José Alencar Gomes da Silva was elected Vice-President of the Republic by the will of the people expressed at the polls on 27 October 2002.

locator.section: Opening by Ramez Tebet ("eleitos em 27 de outubro de 2002"); diploma on pdf p. 5; termo on pdf p. 6

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The record reproduces the TSE diploma, dated Brasília 14 December 2002 and signed by Minister Nelson Jobim as President of the Court with the other members of the Court, stating that José Alencar Gomes da Silva was elected Vice-President of the Republic and qualifying him for investiture in the office before the National Congress on 1 January 2003; the opening and termo date the diplomação to 14 December 2002.

locator.section: Facsimile of the Vice-President's TSE diploma ("foi eleito Vice-Presidente da República"; "Brasília, aos 14 de dezembro de 2002")

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the solemn joint session of 1 January 2003 (opened 15:05), after Lula, Ramez Tebet invited José Alencar Gomes da Silva, "Vice-Presidente da República eleito", to take the constitutional commitment standing, and he recited it.

locator.section: Left column: invitation and "O SR. JOSÉ ALENCAR GOMES DA SILVA - Prometo manter, defender e cumprir a Constituição..."

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Ramez Tebet then declared Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and José Alencar Gomes da Silva empossados as President and Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil respectively, for the period 1 January 2003 to 31 December 2006; the session was opened to give posse to the two, diplomados "para o período a iniciar-se nesta data".

locator.section: Left column: "Declaro empossados nos cargos de Presidente e Vice-Presidente da República Federativa do Brasil ... respectivamente, para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2003 a 31 de dezembro de 2006"; opening on pdf p. 3

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The joint termo de posse, read in the session and reproduced with its signatures, records that at 15:00 on 1 January 2003, before the National Congress in joint session, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and José Alencar Gomes da Silva were solemnly empossados under article 78 of the Constitution as President and Vice-President respectively, elected on 27 October 2002 and diplomados on 14 December 2002, for the period 1 January 2003 to 31 December 2006.

locator.section: Typed termo (both columns); signed facsimile on pdf p. 7 (printed 000007)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Opening his address after the posse, Lula salutes "Exmº Sr. Vice-Presidente da República, José Alencar".
